title: M5 stage24: exact arithmetic repeated-residue tuple count R
scope: Original R character power identity including repetition, k=0 and P=1; no C/A assembly or executable refinement claim.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuple_coordinates
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (T d k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → Fin (T / d)), M5.QuotientCharacter.coordinates P hP (AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t)) = M5.TupleCharacter.vectorSum (fun j : Fin (T / d) => M5.QuotientCharacter.coordinates P hP (AdjoinRoot.mk P ((Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ (d * j.val)))) t
spec.guidance: Unfold tuplePolynomial and vectorSum; ring map mk and linear equivalence coordinates preserve finite sums. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticTuple.numerator_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (T d k : ℕ) (z : AdjoinRoot P), M5.ArithmeticTuple.numerator P hP T d k z = (2 : ℤ) ^ P.natDegree * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin k → Fin (T / d) => AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t) = z)).card : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Instantiate M5.TupleCharacter.ordered_tuple_power_count with monomial quotient coordinates, n=T/d. Unfold QuotientCharacter.value and numerator. Use tuple_coordinates and injectivity of M5.QuotientCharacter.coordinates P hP to equate filters. Do not enumerate tuple pairs; this theorem identifies the arithmetic formula with its semantic count. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticTuple.R_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (T d k : ℕ) (z : AdjoinRoot P), M5.ArithmeticTuple.R P hP T d k z = ((Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin k → Fin (T / d) => AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t) = z)).card : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Unfold R, rewrite numerator_exact, cancel positive integer 2^degree. Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left or omega with pow_pos may help; retain all edge cases. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.ArithmeticTuple.R_nonnegative
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (T d k : ℕ) (z : AdjoinRoot P), 0 ≤ M5.ArithmeticTuple.R P hP T d k z
spec.guidance: Rewrite R_exact and use integer natural-cast nonnegativity. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
